For a specific time span, `leaderboardId` can be set to `ALL` to retrieve data for all leaderboards in a given time span. `NOTE: You cannot ask for 'ALL' leaderboards and 'ALL' timeSpans in the same request; only one parameter may be set to 'ALL'.
